title: UPPAAi: Towards LLM-Assisted Modeling, Verification, Analysis and Synthesis
title_zh: UPPAAi：迈向大语言模型辅助的建模、验证、分析与综合

paragraphs.en: UPPAAi扩展UPPAAL，通过大语言模型对话辅助建模、验证与解释，由模型建议、工具验证。 For more than three decades, UPPAAL has supported the modelling and analysis of real-time and cyber-physical systems. Yet building a suitable model, formalising the intended properties, choosing analysis techniques and interpreting counterexamples remain iterative tasks that demand substantial expertise. Large language models (LLMs) can offer plausible explanations and even solutions, but they are not necessarily correct. We present UPPAAI, an extension of UPPAAL in which users construct, explain, debug and specify models in dialogue with an LLM. The guiding principle is that the user requests, the LLM proposes, explains and orchestrates, and UPPAAL verifies. UPPAAI exposes the UPPAAL editor, queries and verifier through a Tools API. We report on seven case studies, from explaining to a newcomer to learning a controller, covering timed automata, stochastic hybrid automata and strategy learning. LLMs proved to be extremely helpful in not just generating solutions but also pro-actively suggesting relevant UPPAAL features it was not asked about.
paragraphs.zh: UPPAAi扩展UPPAAL，通过大语言模型对话辅助建模、验证与解释，由模型建议、工具验证。三十多年来，UPPAAL一直支持对实时系统与信息物理系统的建模与分析。 然而，构建合适的模型、形式化预期性质、选择分析技术以及解释反例，仍然是需要大量专业知识的迭代性任务。 大语言模型（LLM）可以给出看似合理的解释甚至解决方案，但它们未必正确。 我们提出UPPAAI，这是UPPAAL的一个扩展，用户在其中与大语言模型对话来构建、解释、调试和规约模型。 其指导原则是：用户提出请求，大语言模型进行提议、解释与协调，而由UPPAAL进行验证。 UPPAAI通过一个工具API（Tools API）对外提供UPPAAL的编辑器、查询与验证器。 我们报告了七个案例研究，从向新手讲解到学习一个控制器，涵盖时间自动机、随机混合自动机与策略学习。 实践证明，大语言模型不仅极有助于生成解决方案，还会主动建议用户未曾询问的相关UPPAAL功能。
